column1: # Template BCL Convert (v2) sample sheet for demultiplexing the dual-PCR-barcoded
# pooled binder library on the MiSeq i100.
# Fill in the real index sequences used for each PCR barcoding primer pair and
# save as config/IlluminaSampleSheet.csv (that filename is what scripts/00_bcl_to_fastq.sh
# expects by default; override with --sample-sheet if you name it differently).
# Sample_ID values below match sample_id in config/samples.tsv - keep them identical
# so downstream steps can find the right fastq files automatically.
# NOTE for legacy bcl2fastq users: bcl2fastq expects a [Data] section (not
# and no [BCLConvert_Settings] section. See README.md for why we recommend
# BCL Convert instead for MiSeq i100 output.
